result:
I've built B08: the start screen is now the S6 title and track-select screen, and screen changes play the stripe and chequer overlays. Typecheck, all 732 tests (719 existing, 13 new), the token check, the production build and the screenshot capture all pass. I compared the 844×390 menu screenshot with the S6 mockup and it matches.

**What changed**
- **Title panel:** on the left, a navy panel holds the DAILY AI RACER heading, the three stripes stacked and slanted as in the mockup, and an SVG drawing of the #1 car with the accessible name "Player car #1".
- **Track select:** on the right, a dirt panel shows SELECT TRACK and one card per track. Each card has the track's outline, its name and its stored best time; the selected card turns mustard. The cards are radio cards rather than buttons, so RACE is still the first button and gets focus. Arrow keys move the selection and wrap at the ends.
- **Menu behaviour:** the cards re-read best times every time the menu shows, so a time set during a race appears after QUIT TO MENU. Coming back to the menu re-selects the last track raced.
- **Screen changes:**
  - QUIT TO MENU sweeps the red, mustard and cream stripes, 40 ms apart.
  - RACE, RETRY and NEXT RACE sweep the chequered band.
  - The game state switches straight away. A navy cover moves just behind the last stripe, so the new screen only appears once it has passed, as the plan audit asked.
  - The overlay removes itself after 330 ms.
  - Calling `startRace()` or `showMenu()` directly, which is what the test driver does, plays no overlay. Reduced motion skips it, and a missing `matchMedia` counts as motion allowed.
- **Screen stages:** the `start` stage now has `menu` and `menu-selected`, and a new `screen-change` stage shows `stripes` and `chequer` frozen mid-sweep. To freeze them I added an optional `hold` argument to the overlay function; only the stages use it.
- I removed the start screen's old navy-ground styles from `screens.css`. The `subtitle` option still works so the existing tests pass, but the game no longer sets it. Nothing was listed to delete.

**Choices outside the spec**
- **RESTART RACE:** RESTART RACE on the pause screen has no chequer band, because the spec names only RACE, RETRY and NEXT RACE. UI_RULES says the band is for entering a race, so it may be worth adding there too.
- **Desktop size:** at 1440×900 the menu keeps its phone sizes, like the pause and results screens, so it looks sparse on desktop. There is no desktop mockup for S6, so I filed this in `journal/runs/2026-11-13/design-request.md`.
- **Card press-sink:** board 05 describes a press-sink on cards with no distance given, so cards only lift on hover or focus. That is filed in the same journal file.

**Tests for each acceptance criterion**

| AC | Test file | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| AC1 | `tests/ui/track-select.test.ts` | Card count, names and order are read from the track list, not hard-coded. |
| AC2 | `tests/ui/track-select.test.ts` | A stored value, an invalid value, no value, and storage that throws. |
| AC3 | `tests/ui/track-select.test.ts` | The default selection, clicking, and arrow keys wrapping at both ends. |
| AC4 | `tests/game/track-select-race.test.ts` | Hay Loop races with 6 cars, and is still selected with RACE focused after quitting. |
| AC5 | `tests/game/track-select-race.test.ts` | Dust Bowl reads BEST 0:39.99 after quitting. |
| AC6 | `tests/ui/title-panel.test.ts` | Heading, the three stripes and the #1 car SVG. |
| AC7 | `tests/game/screen-change.test.ts` | Stripes overlay, gone at 330 ms, using fake timers and a stubbed `matchMedia`. |
| AC8 | `tests/game/screen-change.test.ts` | Direct `startRace()` adds no overlay; RACE, RETRY and NEXT RACE play the chequer band. |

The same screen-change file also checks that `window.__racer` adds no overlay and that reduced motion skips it; those two tests carry no AC name because they would also pass on `main`. I couldn't run the AC tests against `main` here because this tree isn't a git checkout. Each one depends on something `main` doesn't have (the radiogroup, the car SVG or the overlay), so they should fail there.
